name: When should I contact a lawyer after an accident on private property?

mainEntity.name: When should I contact a lawyer after an accident on private property?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should contact a lawyer as soon as possible after an accident on private property, especially if your injuries are serious or require ongoing medical treatment. Early consultation allows a lawyer to investigate the scene, gather evidence, identify responsible parties, and ensure proper documentation before evidence disappears or memories fade. Waiting too long might compromise your ability to build a strong case, as there are strict deadlines, known as statutes of limitations, for filing personal injury claims. A timely consultation helps protect your legal rights.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contact a lawyer as soon as possible after a private property accident, particularly if injuries are serious. Early consultation helps preserve evidence and protects your legal rights.
